title: Creative Communications for Lyft
summary: Launch marketing and internal communications design supporting Lyft Business across landing pages, email, presentations, and motion.
overview: Design support for Lyft Business across two workstreams: launch marketing for a new service -- demand-generation landing pages, email templates, and a webinar thank-you landing page -- and internal communications, including motion and animated presentation work.

blocks.title: Launch marketing
blocks.overview: Demand-generation landing pages and email templates supporting a new Lyft Business service launch, plus a dedicated webinar thank-you landing page.

blocks.title: Internal communications
blocks.overview: Motion and animated presentation work for internal Lyft Business communications.
